name: Cedar Course Co. - Order Lookup (tool, demo, not live)

parameters.content:
## Order lookup tool
1. Ask the payment API (placeholder URL api.payments.example.com).
2. If that fails or finds nothing, read the "Orders" sheet instead (the demo data source).
3. Share details only if the order belongs to the WhatsApp number that asked.

Placeholder API answer shape: { id, status, product: { name }, amount, currency, created_at, customer: { phone, name } }.

assignments.name: message
assignments.value: =That does not look like an order number. Order numbers look like CC-1234. Ask the customer to check their receipt email.

meta.templateNote: Demo on made-up data. Not imported into or run on a live n8n instance and not connected to a live WhatsApp number. No credential is configured: every credential is a placeholder with id REPLACE_ME.
